code_lines: /*CIERRE 2021: AJUSTES DE CONTRAGENTE EN EMPRESAS Y HOLDINGS*/
PROC SQL; UPDATE tablas.BD_CTSI SET C_CAGENTE='53',PROC='0600a' WHERE SECTOR IN (51021,5101,37) AND C_SCN='AF.7' AND C_CAGENTE IN ('','71');QUIT;
/*IMPUTA ACTIVO DE CRÉDITOS COMERCIALES EN SECTOR HOGARES CON CA 51, USANDO INFO DEL PASIVO DEL SECTOR 51 CON CA 511 (NEGATIVO DE ESTO)*/
FROM 		TABLAS.BD_CTSI t1, TABLAS.T_SECTORIZACION T2, TABLAS.T_CONTRAPARTIDAS T3
WHERE 		(T1.SECTOR=T2.C_SI AND T1.C_CAGENTE=T3.C_CAGENTE) AND (T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T2.C_SI_SCN_N1='S.11' AND T3.C_SI_SCN_N0='S.14')
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN, CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE, CALCULATED FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC,T1.C_ENTRADA;
/*ELIMINA PASIVO DE CREDITOS COMERCIALES EN SECTOR 51 CON CA 511 (USA CONSULTA ANTERIOR)*/
/*IMPUTA INFO DE ACTIVO DE CREDITOS COMERCIALES EN SECTOR 51 CON CA 53, USANDO EL NEGATIVO DEL PASIVO DEL SECTOR 51 CON CA 511*/
/*IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN ACTIVO DEL SECTOR 352 CON CA 6, USANDO INFO DEL PASIVO DEL SECTOR 6 CON CA 352*/
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.C_CAGENTE='352' AND T1.SECTOR=6)
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN, CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE, CALCULATED FUENTE,CALCULATED PROC,T1.C_ENTRADA;
PROC SQL;/*IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN PASIVO DE SECTOR 352 CON CA 511 USANDO 55% DEL PASIVO DE SECTOR 6 CON CA 352*/
PROC SQL;/*IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN PASIVO DE SECTOR 352 CON CA 51 USANDO 45% DEL PASIVO DE SECTOR 6 CON CA 352*/
PROC SQL;/*IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN ACTIVO DE SECTOR 511 CON CA 352, USANDO 55% DEL PASIVO DE SECTOR 6 CON CA 352*/
PROC SQL;/*IMPUTA CRED COMERCIALES EN ACTIVO DE SECTOR 51 CON CA 352, USANDO 45% DEL PASIVO DE SECTOR 6 CON CA 352*/
/*CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DEL RESTO DEL MUNDO CON CA BCO CENTRAL Y GOBIERNO EN EL ACTIVO DE LOS SECTORES.
REALIZA CONTRA AJUSTE EN CA 53, EXCEPTO EN BCENTRAL QUE AJUSTA EN af.71 CA RM*/
(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=6 THEN INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST.)  ELSE T1.SECTOR END)  AS SECTOR,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR IN (31,41) AND T1.C_CAGENTE='6') OR
(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR=6 AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('31','41'))
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 EN GOBIERNO Y EN AF71 CA RM EN BCENTRAL*/
(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=31 THEN '6' ELSE '53' END) AS C_CAGENTE,
(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=31 THEN 'AF.71' ELSE T1.C_SCN END) AS C_SCN,
(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=31 THEN 'Ajuste conciliación' ELSE T1.N_SCN END) AS N_SCN,
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_RM_P FORCE;RUN;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_53_6 FORCE;RUN;
/*CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES EN ACTIVO DE LOS BANCOS, EXCEPTO CRUCE BANCOS CON BANCOS, CA 41 Y 53.
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('3') THEN INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST.)
WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_CAGENTE='3' THEN 32 ELSE T1.SECTOR END)  AS SECTOR,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR, CHAR7.)) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR IN (321,322,32) AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('321','322','32','41','53','9')) OR
(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR NOT IN (321,41) AND T1.C_CAGENTE IN ('321','322','32','3'))
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR BANCOS*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_BCOS_A FORCE;RUN;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_321_53 FORCE;RUN;
/*CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES AUXILIARES Y OFIS EN ACTIVO DE LOS AUXILIARES FINANCIEROS.
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST.) ELSE T1.SECTOR END)  AS SECTOR,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR, CHAR7.)) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND SUBSTR(LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR7.)),1,2)='36' AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,2) IN ('36','33','37')) OR
(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND SUBSTR(LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR7.)),1,2) IN ('36','33','37') AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,2) IN ('36','37'))
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR AUXILIARES*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_AUX_A FORCE;RUN;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_36_53 FORCE;RUN;
/*CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES AUXILIARES, OFIS Y SEGUROS EN ACTIVO DE LOS SEGUROS.
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST.) ELSE T1.SECTOR END)  AS SECTOR,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR, CHAR7.)) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND SUBSTR(LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR7.)),1,2)='35' AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,2) IN ('36','33','37','35')) OR
(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND SUBSTR(LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR7.)),1,2) IN ('36','33','37','35') AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,2) IN ('35') AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('351_34'))
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR SEGUROS*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_SEG_A FORCE;RUN;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_35_53 FORCE;RUN;
/*CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES BCENTRAL, AUXILIARES, OFIS Y SEGUROS EN ACTIVO DE GOBIERNO.
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST.) ELSE T1.SECTOR END)  AS SECTOR,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR, CHAR7.)) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR IN (4,41,42,412) AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,2) IN ('36','33','37','35','31')) OR
(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND SUBSTR(LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR7.)),1,2) IN ('36','33','37','35','31') AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,1) IN ('4') AND T1.C_CAGENTE NOT IN ('411'))
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR GOBIERNO*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_GOB_A FORCE;RUN;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_4_53 FORCE;RUN;
/*CIERRE 2019. IMPUTA PASIVO DE LOS SECTORES AUXILIARES Y SEGUROS EN ACTIVO DE RESTO DEL MUNDO.
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN INPUT(T1.C_CAGENTE,BEST.) ELSE T1.SECTOR END)  AS SECTOR,
(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR, CHAR7.)) ELSE T1.C_CAGENTE END) AS C_CAGENTE,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='D' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHERE 		(T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND T1.SECTOR=6 AND SUBSTR(T1.C_CAGENTE,1,2) IN ('36','37','35')) OR
(T1.C_ENTRADA='H' AND T1.C_SCN='AF.7' AND SUBSTR(LEFT(PUT(T1.SECTOR,CHAR7.)),1,2) IN ('36','37','35') AND T1.C_CAGENTE='6' )
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR, CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,CALCULATED C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN;
PROC SQL;/*AJUSTA IMPUTACIÓN ANTERIOR EN AF7 CA 53 DEL SECTOR RM*/
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_RM_A FORCE;RUN;
PROC DATASETS; APPEND BASE=TABLAS.BD_CTSI DATA=AF7_6_53 FORCE;RUN;
/*CIERRA CREDITOS COMERCIALES IMPUTANDO DIFERENCIA ENTRE PASIVO Y ACTIVO AL SECTOR 51022 CON CA CORRESPONDIENTE*/
PROC SQL;/*CALCULA TOTAL PASIVO POR CADA SECTOR*/
(CASE WHEN T1.SECTOR=51022 THEN '53' ELSE LEFT(PUT(T2.C_SI_publ,CHAR4.)) END) AS C_CAGENTE,
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN, CALCULATED SECTOR,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE;
PROC SQL;/*CALCULA TOTAL ACTIVO POR CADA SECTOR*/
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.C_CUENTA, t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN, CALCULATED SECTOR,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE;
PROC SQL;/*CALCULA IMP A SECTOR 51022 CON CA RESPECTIVO*/
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE AF7_DELTA,AF7_PASIVO, AF7_ACTIVO;quit;
/*GENERA ACTIVO NETO DE ERRORES Y OMISIONES Y DISCREPANCIA ESTADÍSTICAS, ELIMINANDO EL PASIVO E IMPUTANDOLO CON SIGNO CONTRARIO EN EL ACTIVO*/
GROUP BY 	T1.MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,t1.N_SCN, CALCULATED PROC, CALCULATED FUENTE;
/*IMPUTA ACTIVO DE AF71 EN SECTOR 51 CON CA 53, USANDO TOTAL ACTIVO DE AF71 MULTIPLICADO POR AJUSTE DE CONCILIACIÓN*/
(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN='AF.71' THEN 'Ajuste conciliación' ELSE T1.N_SCN END) AS N_SCN,
WHERE 		(t1.'AÑO'n=t2.'Año'n and t1.TRIM=T2.Trim) AND (T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN IN('AF.71','AF.9') AND T1.DATO<>0)
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,CALCULATED N_SCN, CALCULATED PROC, CALCULATED FUENTE;
(CASE WHEN T1.C_SCN='AF.71' THEN 'Ajuste conciliación' ELSE T1.N_SCN END) AS N_SCN,
WHERE 		(t1.'AÑO'n=t2.'Año'n and t1.TRIM=T2.Trim) AND (T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T1.C_SCN IN('AF.71','AF.9') AND T1.DATO<>0)
GROUP BY 	CALCULATED MONEDA,t1.'AÑO'n, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED SECTOR,CALCULATED C_CAGENTE,T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,t1.C_SCN,CALCULATED N_SCN, CALCULATED PROC, CALCULATED FUENTE;
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_ENTRADA='H' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) AS DATO,
WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Rec Volumen' THEN 'B.10.2' END) AS C_SCN,
WHEN T1.C_CUENTA CONTAINS 'Rec Precio' THEN 'Variaciones del valor neto debidas a ganancias/pérdidas por tenencia nominales'
WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Rec Volumen' THEN 'Variaciones del valor neto debidas a otras variaciones de volumen' END) AS N_SCN,
WHERE 		(T1.C_CUENTA IN('Financiera','Bce Final','Bce Inicio','Rec Volumen','Rec Precio','Rec Precio Reaj'))
PROC SQL; DROP TABLE SALDOS; quit;
